name: Secrets and Credential Hygiene
description: Scan diffs and repository context for leaked secrets, risky credential placement, and over-broad environment exposure.

operational.approval_boundary: May run local secret scanners and redact findings; require human approval before revocation or rotation actions.
operational.use_when: Use when diffs or repository context need secret scanning and credential exposure review.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
